text:
maya: kicking off a compact preflight for cloud marketplace listing uploads (AWS / GCP / Azure). goal: align legal, packaging, SKU mapping, images, and creds. 10am PT quick sync tomorrow. who owns pricing JSON + trial SKU?

sam: I can own pricing mapping + trial SKU. proposing default trial=14d and a dev/startup bundle SKU.

kai: Ian own infra creds, staging buckets, and container pushes for GCP/Azure. need publisher account IDs and IAM role names.

jurgen: legal checklist: marketplace addendum signed, EULA localized, DPA if handling PII, vendor legal sign-off on addendum. ping @maya for link.

natalie: packaging: expose two SKUs: "hosted-api" and "dedicated-reserved". include quickstart, usage limits, and hero assets on the listing.

maya: pulling preflight together below. add blockers by EOD.

- legal: marketplace addendum, EULA, DPA (if required)
- billing: pricing JSON, trial SKU, meter definitions
- assets: logos (SVG/PNG), hero image 1200x600, thumbnails
- images: docker image tags, registry access, image signing notes
- infra: publisher account IDs, IAM roles, staging creds
- QA: purchase/trial activation/cancellation test cases
- telemetry: keys, event mapping, retention

deploy-bot: created issue MP-2218 (assets) and MP-2219 (pricing).

sam: timeline?

maya: soft target = 3 weeks if legal approves on time.

kai: do we need separate flow for private-offer provisioning? AWS/Azure often require it.

sam: yes, include private-offer opt-in field in PR. I'll note in MP-2218.

jurgen: legal review ETA 3-5 business days after handoff; add 2-3 days if vendor legal reviews.

natalie: design: @anna will make hero + icons; I'll post asset spec.

maya: action items: sam -> pricing JSON & trial SKU (48h); kai -> staging creds & registry access (48h); jurgen -> confirm addendum template (72h); natalie -> asset spec & quickstart stub (72h). I'll send calendar invite for 10am sync. React :thumbsup: when you claim.

sam: :thumbsup: attaching sample pricing JSON to MP-2219 by EOD.

kai: :thumbsup: need partnerships-admin to provide publisher account ID. @maya can you loop them in?

maya: looping partnerships-admin offline and attaching doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/market-access/entry-card.

jurgen: flag: any residency claims need explicit EULA language.

natalie: noted, will avoid residency language until legal signs off.

maya: final: if partners want a joint announcement, flag now so comms can draft in parallel.

sam: no announcement for initial listing. revisit post-publish.

maya: thanks everyone. see you on the sync.
